Sean — thanks for kicking this off. Quick notes after a pass through the register and pre-read: 

1) Procurement: legal has flagged two commercial items (data residency clause and a standard termination for convenience) that procurement will insist on. Procurement timeline reported in CRM is 6–8 weeks barring escalations.
2) Revenue/Discount ask: they're signalling >20% discount unless we can guarantee a throughput SLA for a specific route. Recommend we prepare a fallback: 6% on committed usage + performance remediation plan.
3) Health signals: churn risk is correlating with late billing disputes (see support ticket #4312) — need Monica to confirm whether billing disputes are resolved.

Action items for exec note (my suggestions):
- Ask: approval to offer a capped discount tied to Dedicated capacity pilot for 90 days.
- Risk register: move "Procurement delay" to "High" and mark mitigation owner.

Adding product/usage updates:
- Observed a 17% drop in batch embedding jobs from their marketing data pipeline over the last 3 weeks. Top hypothesis: they reduced batch window to stay within budget after a spike in cost.
- Monthly active routes: 5 down to 3; two internal teams paused usage (marketing and BI).

- Short term: enable a free 30-day cache retention bump for their top route (low operational risk, immediate latency/cost win).
- Mid term: propose a quantization profile for their embedding model that reduces cost ~12% with negligible quality loss; recommend A/B on a subset of traffic during the pilot.
